shift-targets.name: Shift Targets
shift-targets.description: Characters with Shift and their shift targets

free.cheapBase.text: Free Shift. Play <BASE> early, then shift <SHIFT> in for 0 ink.

free.midBase.text: Free Shift: <SHIFT> costs no ink, but <BASE> takes longer to set up.

free.expensiveBase.text: Free Shift for <SHIFT>, but <BASE> is expensive and hard to set up first.

duo.cheapHalf.text: Duo Shift: play <BASE> early, then shift <SHIFT> in for 0 ink once its other half is in play too.

duo.midHalf.text: Duo Shift: <SHIFT> costs no ink, but needs its other half in play too, and <BASE> takes longer to set up.

duo.expensiveHalf.text: Duo Shift: <SHIFT> needs its other half in play too, and <BASE> is expensive and hard to set up first.

curve.bothInkable.text: Perfect curve: <SHIFT> shifts onto <BASE> the turn after. Both are inkable as a fallback.

curve.oneInkable.text: Perfect curve: <SHIFT> shifts onto <BASE> the turn after. Only one of them is inkable as a fallback.

curve.neitherInkable.text: On curve: <SHIFT> shifts onto <BASE> the turn after, but neither is inkable, so it's less flexible off-curve.

curve.gap2.text: Smooth curve: <BASE> flows into <SHIFT> in a couple of turns.

curve.gap0.text: Same cost: shifting <SHIFT> onto <BASE> saves no ink, but skips the drying phase.

curve.gap3.text: Wide gap: <SHIFT> shifts onto <BASE> 3 turns after it lands. Playable, but slow to set up.

curve.poor.text: The cost gap makes it hard to set up <BASE> in time to shift <SHIFT> onto it.

drops.basePays.text: Ink-drop Shift: <BASE> gives the ink drops that pay for <SHIFT>.

drops.outside.text: Ink-drop Shift: <BASE> doesn't give the ink drops <SHIFT> needs, so other cards must.

activationBonus.text: <BASE> is a Shift target that also switches on <SHIFT>'s free Shift condition.

templates.ramp-trigger: {RAMP} adds ink to your inkwell, triggering {TRIGGER}'s inkwell effect.
templates.ramp-ramp: {A} and {B} both put extra cards into your inkwell, getting you ahead faster.
templates.ramp-cost: {RAMP} adds extra ink, {COST} discounts your plays.
templates.trigger-trigger: {A} and {B} both trigger when cards go into your inkwell.
templates.cost-cost: {A} and {B} both give ink discounts which stack.
templates.trigger-cost: {TRIGGER} rewards cards going into your inkwell, and {COST} gives ink discounts.
